source_context_translations.translation: The Way that can be spoken is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name.
The nameless is the beginning of heaven and earth; the named is the mother of the ten thousand things.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): A physical path or route for travel.
Sentence Translations (English): A broad road leads to the city.
The cart followed the old road and went on.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To utter words or express something verbally.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Often a simple declarative verb of saying.
Sentence Translations (English): The historian did not dare to say it.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): The fundamental principle or process by which things arise, function, and are ordered; in this context, the ineffable Dao beyond ordinary naming.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Here it refers to the transcendent source of reality, not merely a road or a method.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): Be possible or allowable; expresses capability or permission.
Indicates that something merits a response, treatment, or description; used in evaluative judgments.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Often implies fit or worthiness rather than bare possibility.
Sentence Translations (English): This person is worthy of respect.
This matter must not be neglected.
This wood is fit for timber.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): Indicates possibility, capability, or suitability for the action that follows.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Marks what is possible or permissible in principle.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): Negates a verb, adjective, or clause.
Sentence Translations (English): This is not the right way.
I do not dare to speak.
People are not wood and stone.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): Indicates that a judgment, action, or view is incorrect or should be rejected.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Used in evaluative contrast, not simple negation.
Sentence Translations (English): Right and wrong can be distinguished.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): A simple negative marker used to negate the following predicate or phrase.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Plain negation of the stated relation or quality.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): A stable rule, norm, or method that does not change.
Sentence Translations (English): The people follow the settled norm.
It changes yet does not lose the fixed principle.
The ruler governs the state by a constant method.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): The enduring, unchanging Dao as opposed to the nonconstant, named ways or norms that appear in the world.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Contrasts with transient or nameable ways; here it means the permanently valid Way.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): A word or label by which a person or thing is known.
Sentence Translations (English): I do not know its name.
The name is recorded on bamboo and silk.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To assign or utter a designation for something.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Verbal act of naming or calling.
Sentence Translations (English): By what name shall one call it?

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): A linguistic designation for something, or the act of assigning such a designation.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Here it is the act and result of naming what can be verbally fixed.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): A stable label or official title that does not vary.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Focuses on the stability of the label, not its content.
Sentence Translations (English): Its name is not a fixed name.
This thing has no constant name.
The constant name changes with the time.
One must not cling to a fixed designation.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): A fixed, enduring designation that is stable rather than provisional or changeable.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Opposed to temporary or contingent naming; emphasizes permanence of the designation itself.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): Indicates absence of something or negates existence in a construction.
Sentence Translations (English): There is no lamp in the room.
There is nothing else to do now.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): The condition of being empty, vacant, or void rather than filled or determinate.
Sentence Translations (English): Keep it empty in order to receive what is not yet there.
The ten thousand things arise from nothingness.
The Way is seen in emptiness.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): Denotes absence, lack, or the state in which something is not present; in the Laozi, also the indeterminate origin opposed to named being.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Here it points to absence and to what precedes determinate forms and names.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): The cosmos or all under heaven, viewed as the two great poles of reality.
Sentence Translations (English): Heaven and earth have their constancy.
Heaven and earth do not speak.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): The totality of the cosmos, conventionally expressed as the pair heaven and earth.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): A cosmic pair naming the whole ordered world, not only the sky and the ground.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): Connects a modifier to the noun it qualifies, often indicating possession or close relation.
A demonstrative used in set or literary constructions to indicate a following noun or phrase.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Less common than the particle use, but attested in early texts.
Sentence Translations (English): That young woman is going to her husband’s home.
That place is very far away.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): A possessive or modifying particle linking a noun phrase to the head noun that follows.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Marks attribution, possession, or specification in a compact classical syntax.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): The first stage or initial point of something.
Sentence Translations (English): Only then can one speak of the end.
The ten thousand things have a beginning.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To start an action, process, or state.
Sentence Translations (English): I began to study the Way.
The assembly began to discuss it.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): The point or state from which something starts to arise or come into being.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Here it denotes the primal source or first stage of emergence, not merely the first moment in time.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension
